title: schedule.run@1
description: A plug-in schedule's run (#365), one event per step of its life: queued behind a run still going, dispatched to the plug-in (again, once, after a restart), and ended with its verdict on the schedule's claim. Never the job's own words beyond what the hub decided.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

run.description: The run's handle, which its job is given.

plugin.description: The plug-in whose job it runs.

x-closure.closed: a run is queued, dispatched or ended, and nothing else happens to one
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema

due.description: The time the run was for: its slot, or when you asked for it.

resumed.description: On a dispatch: the run was given to the plug-in again after the hub restarted, its turn accepted before the stop.

verdict.description: On an end: the verdict on the schedule's claim; left out for a run stopped before dispatch.

x-closure.closed: each value is a verdict the claim defines and every reader acts on
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema

cause.description: On an end: why, in the hub's words, such as the secret a BLOCKED run is missing.

stopped.description: On an end: the run was queued when the hub stopped, and never dispatched.

items.description: A handle of what the hub recorded for the run.

changes.description: On an end: what the hub recorded for the run: readings, store items, notices and sends.
